narr: A slow-moving cluster of thunderstorms developed across portions of west central Arkansas during the morning of the 8th, as an upper level disturbance approached the area from the northwest. The atmosphere was unusually moist, which enhanced the rainfall rates from the slow-moving thunderstorms. Locally heavy rainfall resulted in some flash flooding.
ev: Portions of Highway 96 were reported flooded west of Oak Bend Road.
lsr: Report from 911 dispatch of 5-6 inches of water over Highway 96 west of Oak Bend Road intersection.
